method: One throwaway studio and D1 database; baseline and upgraded app records both return the same 140-byte payload.
curl time_starttransfer includes network and TLS. One curl process per sample. Compare only the same cf-ray colo and cold/warm isolate marker.
Server-Timing d1 and do values are counted boundary calls, not duration or SQL statement counts. DO-internal storage work is excluded.
cold=1 means the first HTTP request in that Worker isolate, not proof of a cold D1 connection or newly-created Durable Object. Static assets bypass the Worker; their cache temperature is not known.
Both versions require the expected measurement-only build header. Earlier unmarked batches and the mixed rollout batch are excluded.
Small observational samples; no universal latency or cost improvement is claimed. The baseline live run used migrated additive D1 schema; a separate pre-upgrade canary verifies preservation.
